meta.name: concept-collision-probe
meta.description: The §D13 gate. The primitive table maps 28 letters onto 18 profiles, so ten letters have no profile of their own. This file fixes the test's denominator BEFORE its numerator: the qualification block is committed before a single concept is composed, and the probe block is written only afterwards.
ordering_is_the_protocol: `qualification` is committed first, alone, with `probe` absent.
`probe` is written by scripts/run_collision_probe.py, which refuses to run unless `qualification` is already present, and records the sha256 of the qualification block it ran against.
Discovering afterwards that a class held one usable comparison, or none, would make the real size of the test unstatable in good faith.
meta.sample_is_not_revised: The probe roots are not changed once this table is published. Cleaner single-aṣl alternates exist — بدل/جدل for ب/ج/د, ستر/سكر for ت/ك — and are REJECTED: swapping a sample because the aṣl turned out awkward is choosing roots by looking at the data, the one move the whole protocol exists to prevent.

outcomes.identical: the same multiset of realised primitives, at the same positions, in the same order
outcomes.order-distinct: the same primitives, at different positions or in a different order

criterion.order_distinct_is_a_partial_collision: It is counted and reported as one, never grouped with `distinct` and never filed as a pass: two concepts built from one set of primitives shuffled are separated by the composition rule alone, not by anything the table knows about their letters.
criterion.asl_divergence_rule: A pair counts as aṣl-divergent only when NO aṣl of one root matches ANY aṣl of the other. Comparing whole sets rather than a chosen primary makes divergence harder to establish, so the rule cannot inflate a collision verdict.

size.never_stated_as: 5 pairs — the three ب/ج/د comparisons share their roots and are correlated; counting them as independent tests would inflate the probe's own n by counting the same evidence more than once.
size.fragility: Two of the three classes rest on a single comparison each, so a non-qualifying verdict empties them immediately. Stated here rather than discovered at the table.

decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.one_identical_ends_it: A single `identical` on an aṣl-divergent pair confirms the collision: stop, do not widen, and mapping the five classical مخرج zones becomes v1.0.0 of the table rather than a later lock bump. Tasks 1–3 are redone before anything else proceeds.
decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.emptied_secondary_class: ت/ك or و/ي empty ⇒ run on what qualifies and report the reduced size. No root is added to compensate.
decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.emptied_carrying_class: ب/ج/د empty ⇒ the probe cannot decide: stop and report. Alternates are examined only after that report, and the report must say the substitution followed an EMPTY SAMPLE — not the same thing as choosing after seeing a result, and the reader is owed the distinction rather than asked to trust it.
decision_rules_fixed_in_advance.widening: Only a clean sweep — all three classes `distinct` on aṣl-divergent pairs — licenses extending to ط/ق, ث/ح/ف/ه and م/ن.

excluded_in_every_case.why: Its only real minimal pair is ظلم/غلم, and ظلم is one of the five roots already curated in root_cores.json — contaminated, and therefore useless as evidence in either direction.

withdrawn.why: ريح is not a QAC root key — it is a derivative of ر-و-ح — so the pair had nothing to compare.

classes.why_these_letters: The three share one profile: قَطْع · ظُهور · ارتِداد. Nothing in the table separates them.

asl_segments_verbatim: الحاء والراء والباء أصول ثلاثة: أحدها السلب، والآخر دويبة، والثالث بعض المجالس
الحاء والراء والجيم أصل واحد، وهو معظم الباب وإليه مرجع فروعه، وذلك تجمع الشيء وضيقه
الغضب ; يقال حرد الرجل غضب حردا، بسكون الراء

comparisons.reason: No aṣl of حرب (السلب · دويبة · بعض المجالس) matches any aṣl of حرج (تجمع الشيء وضيقه). Divergent under the set rule.
No aṣl of حرب matches any of حرد (القصد · الغضب · التنحي والعدول). Divergent under the set rule.

حرج's single aṣl (تجمع وضيق) matches none of حرد's three. Recorded caveat: ضيق and غضب are affectively adjacent in usage, but Ibn Fāris states them as aṣl of two different roots and the rule compares stated aṣl, not resemblances. A reader who counts them as matching should read this comparison as non-qualifying and the class as holding 2 of 3.

classes.why_these_letters: Both profile as قَطْع · خَفاء. Nothing in the table separates them.

asl_segments_verbatim: الكاف والباء والراء أصل صحيح يدل على خلاف الصغر

comparisons.reason: تبر's two aṣl (الهلاك · جوهر من جواهر الأرض) match neither كبر's single aṣl (خلاف الصغر) nor each other's field. Divergent under the set rule.

classes.why_these_letters: Both profile as جَرَيان · مَدّ · ظُهور · لِين. Nothing in the table separates them.

asl_segments_verbatim: الكاف والواو والدال كلمة كأنها تدل على التماس شيء ببعض العناء
الكاف والياء والدال أصل صحيح يدل على معالجة لشيء بشدة، ثم يتسع الباب، وكله راجع إلى هذا الأصل

comparisons.reason: كود «التماس شيء ببعض العناء» against كيد «معالجة لشيء بشدة». Divergent: seeking-with-toil and handling-with-force are distinct aṣl, stated separately, on distinct objects. Recorded caveat, because this is the closest call in the table: both aṣl involve exertion applied to a thing, and a reader who treats عناء and شدة as one field should read this comparison as non-qualifying, which empties the و/ي class. Under §D13's emptied-class rule that does not stop the probe — ب/ج/د is the carrying class — and the reduced size would be reported.

summary.verdict: All three classes qualify. The probe runs at full declared size: 7 roots over 3 classes.
summary.caveat_note: Both caveats are recorded so a reader can disagree without re-reading the source. If BOTH were counted as matching, ب/ج/د would still hold 2 qualifying comparisons and the probe would still run — the carrying class does not depend on either call.

qualification.ordering_evidence: This block was authored and written to disk before `linguistics/lisan/concept/compose.py` existed, so no concept could have been composed when the denominator was fixed. Two things carry that claim rather than asking for trust: the probe block pins this block's sha256, so a qualification rewritten after the run stops matching its own record; and the whole change is still uncommitted, so the git history has NOT yet been split. It SHOULD be — this block and the frozen datasets in one commit, the engine and the probe record in the next — and until that split exists the ordering rests on the digest alone. Recorded here rather than claimed away.
